owner_definitions.rule: A deterministic engine can decide the typical case with high confidence.
owner_definitions.ai: The decisive check is semantic or visual — rules can’t judge “meaning.” A rule may still catch a sub-part.
owner_definitions.human: Requires human judgment, interactive/assistive-tech testing, media-content review, or whole-process knowledge.

criteria.rationale: Rule catches missing alt; AI judges if alt is meaningful & decorative-vs-informative. POC checker.
Needs a human to judge whether the text/audio alternative is present & adequate.
Rule can flag a missing caption track; caption accuracy & sync need human review.

secondary_checks.note: Rule can flag a missing caption track

criteria.rationale: Requires human judgment of whether description is needed & adequate.
Live caption presence/accuracy — human/operational.
Whether/what to describe — human judgment.
Rule catches some structure; AI catches fake semantics (visual heading coded as div, fake lists/tables). POC checker.
Compare DOM/reading order vs visual order — visual+DOM reasoning; AI-extendable.
Detect instructions relying on shape/size/location (“the round button”); NLP/visual.
Detect orientation lock in CSS/meta — automatable.
Check autocomplete tokens on common inputs — automatable.
AI detects info conveyed by colour alone with no text/pattern alternative. POC checker.
Detect auto-playing audio >3s without a control — automatable.
Text contrast ratio — deterministic maths. (Edge cases: logos/incidental.)
Render at 200% & detect loss/clipping — mostly automatable (visual confirm helps).
Detect text baked into images (OCR/vision) — AI-extendable.
Render at 320px/400% & detect 2-D scroll — automatable via rendering.
UI/graphic contrast ≥3:1 — computable, but “which graphics matter” needs some review.
Apply spacing overrides & detect clipping — automatable.
Dismissible/hoverable/persistent — needs interaction testing (agentic Phase 2).
All functionality keyboard-operable — interaction testing (agentic Phase 2).
Tab through & detect traps — interaction (agentic Phase 2).
Single-key shortcuts remappable/off — largely human.
Whether time limits exist & are adjustable — human.
Rule detects moving content; verifying a control needs interaction.
Flash analysis is partly automatable on video but largely human-verified.
Detect skip link / landmarks — automatable.
Title present & non-empty — automatable (descriptiveness = AI enhancement).

secondary_checks.note: Title present & non-empty — automatable (descriptiveness = AI enhancement).

criteria.rationale: Focus order preserves meaning — interaction + judgment (agentic Phase 2).
Rule flags empty/“click here”; AI judges if link text is meaningful in context.
>1 way to find pages — site-level judgment.
AI judges if headings/labels are descriptive (partially touched by POC semantics checker).
Rule detects outline:none; AI/visual confirms a visible focus indicator.
Focused element not hidden by sticky UI — interaction + visual (agentic Phase 2).
Multipoint/path gestures need single-pointer alt — interaction.
Down-event behaviour — interaction testing.
Visible label text must be in the accessible name — AI/string comparison. POC checker.
Device-motion features & alternatives — human.
Drag actions need single-pointer alt — interaction.
Targets ≥24×24px (with exceptions) — geometry, automatable.
Valid lang attribute — automatable.
Detect lang on parts in other languages — largely automatable.
No unexpected context change on focus — interaction (agentic Phase 2).
No surprise change on input — interaction (agentic Phase 2).
Nav consistent across pages — cross-page compare (AI-assist Phase 2).
